steps.title: Project Architecture & Meta Configuration
steps.description: Initialize app-meta and API schema defining products, orders, and offline pricing logic.

steps.title: Responsive Storefront Layout & Header
steps.description: Construct HTML5 skeleton with Tailwind CSS v4, top banner, search bar, and cart drawer toggle.

steps.title: High-Conversion Hero & Category Navigation
steps.description: Design dynamic category badges (Sneakers, Formal, Sports, Loafers, Boots) and promotional shoe banners.

steps.title: Shoe Catalog & Dynamic Product Grid
steps.description: Implement responsive multi-card product grid showcasing shoe images, pricing, discount tags, and size chips.

steps.title: Shoe Detail Modal & Multi-Angle Image Viewer
steps.description: Build interactive shoe preview with size picker (UK 6 to 10), high-res photo gallery, and stock status.

steps.title: Cart & Live Price Engine
steps.description: Implement local cart state with dynamic subtotal, delivery calculation, discount calculation, and badge updates.

steps.title: WhatsApp One-Click Direct Ordering
steps.description: Generate formatted WhatsApp messages with selected shoe items, sizes, delivery address, and final total.

steps.title: Backend API Client & Authentication Handlers
steps.description: Integrate backend endpoints for login, signup, token persistence, and forgot-password OTP recovery.

steps.title: Online Checkout & Order Persistence
steps.description: Process orders via backend /data endpoint with Cash On Delivery & UPI simulation.

steps.title: Owner Product Upload & Management Drawer
steps.description: Empower Nitin to add new shoe listings with photo URLs, custom sizes, prices, and instant catalog refresh.

steps.title: Customer Orders History View
steps.description: Display previous purchases and live order tracking details for authenticated customers.

steps.title: Building nitinshoesstore
steps.description: Finalize polish, optimize mobile responsiveness, test search and cart computations, and ship application.
